sink.expr: db.Exec("DELETE FROM users WHERE id=?", userID)

path.expr: db.Exec("DELETE FROM users WHERE id=?", userID)

sanitizers.description: database/sql parameterized query with ? placeholder; userID bound as a separate argument, not concatenated

notes: SQL injection is NOT exploitable here — the query uses a constant template with a ? placeholder and userID is bound as a parameter. NOTE: this handler carries a separate, serious authorization bypass (no authz middleware on a destructive DELETE) handled by the authz tracer (authz-findings.json).
